prompt: Security reran the token-theft drill and it went badly: a refresh token that had already been rotated out still works, and when we replayed a stolen token only the replayed token died - the rest of the session family survived, and access tokens issued before we killed the session kept working. Users are also saying they get signed out about a week after login no matter how active they are, and the admin session listing shows sessions that ended long ago. The behaviour we agreed with security is written down in docs/; the reproductions under test/ are what we managed to capture, not the whole acceptance criteria.
